verdict.rationale: Cognee's documented `.forget` operation is a unified deletion command. It covers single data item deletion, whole-dataset deletion including its graph and vector data, and full cleanup of everything the current user can delete, which covers the single-memory and full-erasure parts of the story. Per-entity deletion is not documented: dataset deletion is per-dataset, not per extracted entity or subject. missing for 10: documented per-entity deletion (e.g., all memories about a specific person or entity), confirmation that session/short-term memory is also erased, admin-driven erasure on behalf of another user, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can delete a user's memories on demand — single memory, per-entity, or full erasure — to satisfy privacy requirements

citations.quote: The `.forget` operation is the unified deletion command in Cognee v1.0.
Single data item deletion: remove one data item from a dataset. Dataset deletion: remove an entire dataset and its graph/vector data. Full cleanup: remove everything the current user can delete.
Remove a data item, an entire dataset, or all memory for the current user.
